description_en: Creates a new session under a specified DataAgent and returns the ID of the new session
description_zh: 在指定的 DataAgent 下创建一个新的会话，并返回新会话的 ID
name: CreateThread

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataAgent, which is passed in the request path to specify the DataAgent under which the session is created
parameters.help_zh: DataAgent 的名称，通过请求路径传入，用于指定在哪个 DataAgent 下创建会话
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The custom attributes of the session. Both keys and values are strings, which can be used to tag the session or carry business context
parameters.help_zh: 会话的自定义属性，键与值均为字符串，可用于标记会话或携带业务上下文
parameters.name: attributes

parameters.help_en: The session title. You do not need to specify this parameter during creation. The service automatically generates and maintains the session title based on the conversation content. To customize the title, call UpdateThread after the session is created
parameters.help_zh: 会话标题。创建时无需传入：会话标题由服务根据对话内容自动生成与维护，如需自定义请在会话创建后调用 UpdateThread 修改
parameters.name: title

fields.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project associated with the session
fields.help_zh: 会话关联的日志服务 Project 名称
fields.name: project

fields.help_en: The name of the workspace associated with the session
fields.help_zh: 会话关联的工作空间（Workspace）名称
fields.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The context variables of the session, which are used to restrict the session to specified Simple Log Service resources
parameters.help_zh: 会话的上下文变量，用于把会话限定在指定的日志服务资源范围内
parameters.name: variables

schema.description_en: The response body, which returns the identifier of the newly created session
schema.description_zh: 响应体。返回新建会话的标识

requestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate the call during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的 ID，用于问题排查时定位本次调用

threadId.description_en: The ID of the newly created session. It is used when you initiate a conversation by calling CreateChat, or when you query, modify, or delete the session
threadId.description_zh: 新建会话的 ID。后续发起对话（CreateChat）以及查询、修改、删除该会话时都使用它

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body, which contains the initial configuration of the new session. All fields are optional
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。新会话的初始配置，所有字段均可省略
v1_body_parameters.name: body
